title: Masala Chai
objective: Teach a home cook to make two cups of masala chai in four clear steps, readable with the sound off, and make the process feel warm and unhurried.
audience: Home cooks who have never made chai from whole spices; social viewers scrolling with sound off.

other: Poster frame from the title scene

message.core_message: Good chai is whole spices, tea and milk, simmered patiently: four steps.
key_points: What you need for two cups
Brew the tea, add milk, bring to a boil

constraints: Readable with sound off at phone size
Each format gets its own arrangement (no crops of the landscape layout)
No photography or stock footage: illustration only, so there are no third-party image rights to clear
Quantities are a typical home recipe, not nutritional or health claims

audio.notes: Silent by default (sound-off social). If music is added later it must be licensed and recorded in project.json audio.music.license; no SFX unless it serves the pour and simmer moments.

research.reason: A common stovetop method with no factual, technical or scientific claims beyond quantities and steps.

creative_directions.name: Ink and steam: an editorial cookbook page
creative_directions.concept: The film is a living cookbook page. One ink line drawing of a saucepan stays on the page for the whole recipe and changes with each step (spices land, water rises, tea and milk colour it), while the copy column turns like a page. The pan is the constant; only what is in it changes.

visual_identity.palette: Warm ivory paper and warm ink; terracotta for numerals and emphasis; cardamom green, ginger yellow and chai caramel inside the drawing only.
visual_identity.typography: Playfair Display headlines with an italic accent word, Inter body, JetBrains Mono quantities.
visual_identity.texture: Subtle static paper grain; hand-drawn counter line.
visual_identity.imagery: Single-weight ink line illustration with flat fills.

signature_moves: Strokes that draw at a steady pen speed
Lines of type rising out of masks
A liquid rise that becomes the next shot
A match cut from the poured glass to the closing mark
motion_language.transitions: Page-turn wipe into the ingredients, in-place copy changes over a persistent drawing, liquid rise into the serve, match cut into the end card.

composition.approach: Editorial split: one persistent illustration panel and one copy column.
composition.portrait: Illustration in the upper half above the copy; caption zone kept clear.
composition.square: Illustration on top, copy below; the ingredient list switches to two columns.

creative_directions.pacing: Unhurried: about four seconds per step, each hold sized to its reading time.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Clarity first for a how-to, light by default, and the evolving single drawing makes the four steps feel like one continuous act of cooking.
creative_directions.risks: Line art can feel sparse; colour inside the pan and the liquid transition carry the warmth.

creative_directions.name: Kitchen collage: cut paper on the counter
creative_directions.concept: An overhead kitchen counter made of cut paper. Ingredients are sticker cut-outs that pop onto the counter and slide into the pan; each step is a new arrangement of paper pieces.

visual_identity.palette: Kraft and cream paper with saturated spice colours (turmeric, tomato, cardamom).
visual_identity.texture: Deckle edges, paper shadows, light grain.
visual_identity.imagery: Flat cut-paper shapes seen from above.

motion_language.transitions: Shape covers between steps on a quick rhythm.

composition.approach: Overhead flat-lay: the pan in the centre, ingredients orbiting it, type set on paper tags.
composition.portrait: Pan low in frame, tags stacked above.

creative_directions.pacing: Brisk and rhythmic, three to four seconds per step.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Very social-friendly and memorable; strongest if the brief later adds music.
creative_directions.risks: Busier frames make the quantities harder to read with sound off.

creative_directions.name: Night brew: a slow cinematic pour
creative_directions.concept: A late-night ritual: a single vessel lit in warm brass against near-black, steam drifting through slow camera pushes, with letterboxed captions for each step.

visual_identity.palette: Near-black with brass highlights and chai amber.
visual_identity.typography: Oswald capitals with EB Garamond italics.

composition.approach: Centred hero object with letterboxed captions; symmetrical in every format.

creative_directions.pacing: Slow, seven to eight seconds per step; would exceed the 32 s ceiling unless steps are merged.
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Strong mood for a brand film rather than a how-to.
creative_directions.risks: Contradicts the light-first default and the sound-off clarity goal; recommended only if the brief turns into a brand piece.

selection_rationale: The objective is instruction with the sound off. Ink and steam keeps every step legible, honours the light-first default and gives the most continuity (one drawing that cooks). Kitchen collage is the alternative for a music-led social campaign; Night brew suits a brand film, not a recipe.
success_criteria: Every step's text stays on screen at least its reading time
Quantities readable at phone size in the portrait cut
Each format has an intentional layout
The closing title holds for at least two seconds
